items.title: Green production and consumption of textiles and apparel ...
items.content: Jun 1, 2024 · Future considerations and developments in sustainability in spinning, fabric production, wet processing, and garment manufacturing are explored in this review article. It delves into environmental issues and the ways in which modern clothing brands promote sustainable technologies and materials.
